integrity: The all-parameter statement is proved from the zonotope determinant formula and exact affine coefficients. The packaged checker recomputes those coefficients using integer arithmetic; no finite sampling is used as a substitute for the sign proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for the one-parameter scaling of the special generator in the displayed Skorupinski configuration; it does not classify arbitrary rescalings or all six-generator zonotopes.
title: Exact scale phase diagram for a four-dimensional zonotope log-submodularity defect
